reference.title: Scenario 1 — copyright section mapped to frontmatter
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document that begins with a section titled "Copyright Notice" styled as Heading 1,

section.p: Consider a document that begins with a section titled "Copyright Notice" styled as Heading 1, followed by a Normal paragraph containing the legal boilerplate.

row.entry: [Heading 1]: Copyright Notice [Normal]: Copyright © 2026 Company Name. All rights reserved

entry.codeblock:
Printer User's Guide Copyright Notice

Copyright © 2026 Company Name. All rights reserved.

section.p: Result:The converter recognizes the heading text "Copyright Notice" as <frontmatter> content and places the generated topic under <frontmatter> using <notices> rather than treating it as a regular chapter. Similarly, the Preface or Abstract headings are also added in the front matter.
section.note: If the preface, copyright, notice is added as a normal paragraph and not the heading or custom style, the conversion may add all of them together in the preceding topic.
